what: 1px line under text links — the default type is hidden and on hover is drawn from the left over .5s ease-out, retracting to the right on release. The always type has a line that is always drawn and on hover retracts to the right (40% of .6s), stays empty briefly (until 60%), then is drawn again from the left

options.look: always: A line that is always drawn clears once when a hand hovers and is drawn again (original breadcrumb and tag links)
options.look: always-half: Same as always, but retract and redraw split in halves (0→50% retract, 51→100% redraw) — Brand link .7s
options.--fx-ease: Default type draw curve, default ease-out — brand uses ease(.4s)
options.look: always-gap: Same as always, but it retracts at 30%, empties up to 65%, and is redrawn — Brand text button .5s (--fx-redraw: .5s, 2px line)
options.look: back: Because the line is anchored on the left, when you let go it shrinks back the way it came instead of clearing to the right (Brand site: --fx-ease cubic-bezier(0,0,.56,.99))
options.look: clip-half: A line that is always drawn is swept off to the right end with clip-path (0→50%) and reopened from the left (51→100%) — it also runs when hovering the wrapping parent (link panel). Hotel site Reservation text 1.3s
options.--fx-redraw-ease: clip-half redraw curve, default ease — uds-brand uses cubic-bezier(.65,0,.35,1)
